purpose_and_decision_use: Determine whether empirical evidence on interaction testing or boundary-value/observability methods improves R07-R08 focused investigation and identify a simpler fixture-first alternative.
prompt: Read only p204's supplied contract, scenario, source index and assigned excerpt units R07, R08, R11 and R13, plus relevant original empirical research or first-party references on interaction testing, observational oracles, and selection of small discriminating cases. Do not inspect other views, working trees, results or unreleased events; do not execute code. Map wheel/focus/overflow, model/canvas and flow/consumer paths only where supported, including retained-input consumer limitations. Compare an explicitly controlled small fixture with combinatorial approaches; retain contrary evidence and conditions where general empirical findings do not transfer. Identify missing project/mode and input evidence and a next falsifier per symptom. Return exact excerpt references, primary links and context, rejected leads, and non-execution limits. Stop on duplicate or non-actionable evidence; at most 16 logical web operations, 8 queries and 10 opens.
expected_artifact: Compact cited source and research map for wheel, canvas and flow with practical experimental alternatives.
model_rationale: Pinned Luna-high is suitable for bounded independent coverage and alternative discovery, subject to Terra screening.
